tools.name: search_beaches
tools.description: Search and filter the atlas. All filters optional and combinable. Returns compact records; use get_beach for a full profile.

tools.name: get_beach
tools.description: Full profile of one beach by id (its slug, from search results), by Wikidata Q-id, or by name.

tools.name: warmest_beaches_in_month
tools.description: Beaches ranked by their MEAN sea temperature in one month, warmest first. This is the question the atlas exists to answer: "where can I swim in February?". Beaches with no measurement are excluded rather than ranked as cold.

tools.name: sea_temperature_year
tools.description: The twelve monthly means for one beach, plus the months that reach 20 °C. Answers "when is it warm enough there?".
